newsitem.title: IRAN: Lebanese parliamentary speaker to visit Iran.
newsitem.headline: Lebanese parliamentary speaker to visit Iran.

text.p: Lebanese parliamentary speaker Nabih Berri will visit Tehran in September to meet Iran's new president, Mohammad Khatami, the government-owned Iran Daily newspaper said on Tuesday.
It said Berri would also meet Khatami's predecessor, Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani, who hands over the presidency on August 3.
The Lebanese speaker would discuss bilateral relations and Middle East developments with senior Iranian officials, it quoted Lebanese sources as saying.
